fichas.title: Preparation of and Collaboration in Tendering
fichas.summary: Describes the tendering and contract-award process, the contents of tender documents, and basic and special services involved in preparing and assessing tenders. Explains bills of quantities and performance specifications, and illustrates three ways to present quantities and unit prices for a concrete ground-slab item.
uses: Prepare tender documents and works specifications
Obtain, check, assess, and compare tenders
Form a building contract from accepted tender documents
